questions.q: Where did Mrs. Rabbit tell her children NOT to go?
choices: Mr. McGregor's garden
Down the lane to the wood
Into the far fields
To the baker's shop
questions.evidence: don't go into Mr. McGregor's garden

questions.q: Where did the rabbit family live?
choices: In a sand-bank under a big fir-tree
In a hole in Mr. McGregor's garden
In a little tool-shed by the wood
Under a gooseberry bush in a field
questions.evidence: They lived with their Mother in a sand-bank, underneath the root of a very big fir-tree.

questions.q: What did Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail do while Peter went to the garden?
choices: Gathered blackberries in the lane
Went to the baker's with their Mother
Stayed at home and slept all day
Followed Peter into the garden
questions.evidence: went down the lane to gather blackberries

questions.q: What did Peter eat first in the garden?
choices: Lettuces and French beans
Some radishes and carrots
Parsley and some cabbages
Cabbages and new potatoes
questions.evidence: First he ate some lettuces and some French beans

questions.q: How did Peter get caught in the gooseberry net?
choices: The buttons on his jacket got stuck
His new shoes got tangled up in it
His long ears got stuck in the net
He fell asleep under it and got caught
questions.evidence: got caught by the large buttons on his jacket

questions.q: Why was the watering can a bad place to hide?
choices: It had too much water in it
It was much too small for him
Mr. McGregor was holding it
It had a big hole in the bottom
questions.evidence: if it had not had so much water in it

questions.q: What gave Peter away while he was hiding in the tool-shed?
choices: He sneezed
He cried loudly
His tail stuck out
He knocked over a pot

questions.q: Why did Peter leave the white cat alone?
choices: His cousin Benjamin had told him about cats
The cat was fast asleep in the warm sunshine
The cat was a good friend of Mr. McGregor's
He was much too tired to stop and talk
questions.evidence: he had heard about cats from his cousin, little Benjamin Bunny

questions.q: What did Mr. McGregor do with Peter's jacket and shoes?
choices: Made a scare-crow with them
Gave them to Mrs. Rabbit
Threw them in the pond
Burned them on a bonfire
questions.evidence: hung up the little jacket and the shoes for a scare-crow

questions.q: What happened to Peter because he didn't listen to his mother?
choices: He lost his clothes and felt sick that night
He got a big supper of bread, milk and blackberries
He made a new friend in the garden, the white cat
Nothing bad happened to him at all
questions.evidence: Peter was not very well during the evening
